name: SikaRoof TurfPave XD

SIKAROOF® TURFPAVE® XD: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD, July 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sikaroof-turfpavexd.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD is a high strength grass and gravel stabilisation module designed to create permeable and green pathways for heavy emergency vehicles, and functions as an erosion control measure. Modules are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) with cells 40 mm high, providing protection against soil and root compaction.
    - SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD modules interlock with adjacent modules for easy installations and are placed directly on a bed of levelling sand, on the compacted hardcore and sub-base.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Grass and gravel stabilisation and drainage layer for heavy emergency vehicle roadways and pedestrian pathways.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: GRASS AND GRAVEL PAVER MODULES FOR PERMEABLE PATHWAYS
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM D695-15: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Increased soil stability
    - Increased loading capacity of permeable green surfaces
    - Modules interlock adjacently for uniform coverage
    - Vertical webs to minimise girdling of roots
    - Flexible connecting grids allow modules conform to uneven surfaces
    - Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
    - Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
    - Operates within a wide service temperature range
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Black grid square modules
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: 500 x 500 x 40 mm
    - Weight: 4.3 kg/m²
    - Service temperature: - 30 °C to 80 °C
2.7 Compressive strength.
    | Unfilled | Sand Filled |
    | 1,450 kN/m² | 29,400 kN/m² |
    Test method printed: (ASTM D695-15)
2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD: 8 pieces / bundle
    - Shelf life: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet
2.9 Storage conditions. Bundles must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate preparation. Sub-base shall be excavated and levelled to a depth dependent on the amount of compacted sand or gravel base using a mechanical plate compactor or compaction roller to meet the design load specifications. Base course shall be laid down and compacted with washed sand or 2 - 5 mm gravel or whichever meets road base construction specifications.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (July 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application. SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD shall be loosely laid on a layer of levelling sand if the surface is uneven, and interlocked with adjacent modules connected by proprietary in-built clips to form a continuous grass and gravel paver and drainage layer without any mechanical fixing to the compacted hardcore or sub-base. The installed grass and gravel paver and drainage modules would then be filled with the appropriate infill material.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD is not resistant to permanent weathering or prolonged UV exposure.
    For more information, please contact the Sika Sales Personnel

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (July 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: Unfilled | Sand Filled; 1,450 kN/m² | 29,400 kN/m² (ASTM D695-15)
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD, July 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/u/sikaroof-turfpavexd.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
